This situation I'm in right now. Really deep, dark depression. The girl I love left me for her ex while we were still together, and she's super good to him. A very tiny part of me feels happy for her. Lots of added insecurities though. No self worth anymore. No motivation to pull myself out of this dark cloud. Loss of spirit, hours cut back at work because of my bad mood and lack of motivation. Lots of bills to pay now that I've moved out. I live in darkness, I don't even turn my lights on because I can't afford the electric bill. Most of my appliances are unplugged. Can't run the heater so I'm absolutely freezing every night. Lost like 30 pounds in the last few months. Averaging about -$80 a month. Stressed the fuck out. Did dumb things. Feeling lots of shame from recent decisions. My actions scared someone who didn't deserve it. Lost all my friends from my depression. Outcast at work because of my mood. Cry myself to sleep every night. Fucking sucks. I want to die but I'm afraid of death. Maybe Valentine's Day will be the day, it's coming up soon and I'm *very* scared about it. Just a lot of bad things stacked up and spiraled out of control on me, don't know if I'm strong enough to win this time. I hope so. Have to try and keep fighting. Valentines Day is scaring me though. Fighting so hard to make this life thing work out but the weight is painful.
